from pathlib import Path
import json

home=Path.home()
tid='DEV-PRED-ASTRA-AUTONOMOUS-MODEL-DETAILS-20261005'
candidates=[
    home/'.local/state/prediction-project-executor'/f'{tid}.json',
    home/'prediction_research_prod/control/results'/tid/'RESULT.json',
    home/'prediction_research_prod/control/results'/tid/'stdout.log',
    home/'prediction_research_prod/control/results'/tid/'stderr.log',
]
for p in candidates:
    print('PATH='+str(p),flush=True)
    print('EXISTS='+str(p.exists()),flush=True)
    if not p.exists():
        continue
    try:
        txt=p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    except Exception as exc:
        print('READ_ERROR='+type(exc).__name__,flush=True)
        continue
    print('CONTENT_BEGIN',flush=True)
    print(txt[-12000:],flush=True)
    print('CONTENT_END',flush=True)
